comparison.objective: Pipe a joined ridged shell border on a cake.
comparison.physical_skill: Pressure–motion coordination, repeated material deposition, and clean tool release.
comparison.success_condition: Specified length and count of connected shells with bounded head, tail, ridge, gap, and cleanliness measurements.
comparison.reason: This is controlled deformable-material deposition and shape formation, not rigid bearing-carriage transfer or rolling-element containment.
